prompt: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
response_text:
I get the frustration, but calling any president “stupid” usually oversimplifies what’s going on.

Presidents make decisions in messy, high-pressure situations with incomplete information, competing advisors, and political tradeoffs. What can look like an obviously bad or “dumb” decision from the outside is often the result of prioritizing certain goals over others, or responding to constraints the public doesn’t see.

Also, a lot of how we judge presidents depends on our own values and expectations. If their policies clash with what you think is right or effective, it can feel like incompetence—even if they (and their supporters) see it as deliberate strategy.

If you want, tell me which specific actions or decisions you’re thinking about, and I can break those down more concretely.
